answer: Stop sybils with an inlet toll: each agent pays a toll at one inlet and receives a jetty receipt for its work. Verifiers run ripple audits, tracing receipts to catch copies; a receipt under two identities voids both and slashes bonds. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 tolls and receipts at 13x honest cost each: each receipt fits one inlet and one jetty ledger entry, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents pay once, keep full rights.
